description: This file defines an API endpoint for retrieving streaming video information, including video URL and DRM token. It uses FastAPI's APIRouter to set up the route and Pydantic models for data serialization.

classes.name: VideoPlaybackInfo
classes.description: Pydantic model representing the video playback information, including URL and optional DRM token.

methods.name: get_stream_info(video_id: int = Path(..., description="ID of the video to play"))
methods.description: Asynchronous function that returns video streaming URL and DRM token for a given video ID.

ctags.name: get_stream_info
ctags.pattern: /^async def get_stream_info(video_id: int = Path(..., description="ID of the video to play")):$/
ctags.signature: (video_id: int = Path(..., description="ID of the video to play"))
